# update

Release check, minisign-verified apply, in-place restart with sessions re-adopted.

Read first: `docs/features/update/spec.md`, `docs/features/update/contract.md`

- `kb:adr/process-features-widened-for-a-refactor-call-site` — A plan whose sibling-matching refactor forces a one-line call-site repair in another feature's file widens its Features header rather than revert the refactor. (accepted, 2026-09-25; features: update, connection, surfaces) → `docs/adr/process-features-widened-for-a-refactor-call-site.md`
- `kb:adr/release-latest-resolved-via-redirect-not-api` — Latest release is resolved by reading the releases-latest redirect, which is unmetered, never the REST API with its sixty unauthenticated calls an hour. (accepted, 2026-09-10; features: release, update) → `docs/adr/release-latest-resolved-via-redirect-not-api.md`
- `kb:adr/stack-selfupdate-minisign-library` — Signature verification for self-update uses the aead.dev minisign module rather than hand-rolled Ed25519 plus BLAKE2b; same dependency count, less code. (accepted, 2026-09-10; features: update) → `docs/adr/stack-selfupdate-minisign-library.md`
- `kb:adr/update-check-pref-governs-automatic-checking-only` — The update-check pref governs the daemon's automatic schedule only; a user-initiated check always runs, and canCheck says when one is possible. (accepted, 2026-09-22; features: update, settings) → `docs/adr/update-check-pref-governs-automatic-checking-only.md`
- `kb:adr/update-check-runs-in-daemon-daily` — The update check runs in the daemon after listen and then daily via the redirect; an empty base URL disables checking and apply, as every test daemon sets. (accepted, 2026-09-10; features: update) → `docs/adr/update-check-runs-in-daemon-daily.md`
- `kb:adr/update-failure-one-sentence-chain-in-log` — A failed check or apply reaches the wire as one sentence naming the innermost cause, never a URL; the full error chain goes to the daemon log at warn. (accepted, 2026-09-25; features: update) → `docs/adr/update-failure-one-sentence-chain-in-log.md`
- `kb:adr/update-install-rechecked-on-every-check` — The installer-or-unmanaged half of the install classification is re-derived at the start of every release check; dev and homebrew stay fixed from startup. (accepted, 2026-09-25; features: update) → `docs/adr/update-install-rechecked-on-every-check.md`
- `kb:adr/update-manual-check-is-a-synchronous-post` — A user-initiated update check is a synchronous POST returning the result or an error, not a 202 plus a new check phase on the update broadcast. (accepted, 2026-09-22; features: update) → `docs/adr/update-manual-check-is-a-synchronous-post.md`
- `kb:adr/update-release-knowledge-in-selfupdate-package` — All GitHub-release knowledge lives in one package; the server owns the poller and wire, the command owns the flag, install classification and re-exec. (accepted, 2026-09-10; features: update) → `docs/adr/update-release-knowledge-in-selfupdate-package.md`
- `kb:adr/update-remedy-names-path-and-cause` — An unmanaged install's remedy names the running binary's resolved path and the concrete reason it can't be updated, never a claim about who installed it. (accepted, 2026-09-25; features: update) → `docs/adr/update-remedy-names-path-and-cause.md`
- `kb:adr/update-restart-is-in-place-reexec-not-shutdown` — Restart after an update stops listeners and store gracefully, never consults the on-exit policy or kills a session, then execs the new binary in place. (accepted, 2026-09-10; features: update) → `docs/adr/update-restart-is-in-place-reexec-not-shutdown.md`
- `kb:adr/update-restart-reloads-dashboard` — A window that saw an update restart shows the banner as updating while the daemon is down, reloads on reconnect, and confirms the version it came back as. (accepted, 2026-09-25; features: update, connection) → `docs/adr/update-restart-reloads-dashboard.md`
- `kb:adr/update-trust-root-minisign-signed-checksums` — A release applies only if its checksums file carries a valid minisign signature against a compiled-in key and the archive's SHA-256 matches; no unsigned. (accepted, 2026-09-10; features: update, release) → `docs/adr/update-trust-root-minisign-signed-checksums.md`
